cohort: Females with parity > 1 who delivered in major provinces of Pakistan between October 2016 and September 2017.
finding: Previous history of preterm birth, stillbirth, C-section, PROM, and inter-pregnancy interval <12 months were associated with increased risk of preterm birth.
mod_finding: Previous history of C-section was associated with increased risk of preterm birth (OR = 2.044).
